name: Driver - Saints Row 4
author: edtechtris
description:
Followed Create with Code by Unity and replaced some of the assets with some inspiration from Saints Row 4

Created for Spring 2022 Universe Intro to C# and Unity
Environment from package files included with Unity's Create with Code free online course 
Professor Genki model made in ShapesXR, exported through Blender to .fbx, then added to Unity with sphere collider
Car is free asset from Unity Asset Store
